name: Claude Code operations kit
thesis: Developers who already run Claude Code pay US$10–33 on Leanpub for operations handbooks (11–13 copies each for the four of this exact shape, 81–530 for the broader guides); a 20–30k-word handbook of how a real unattended operation runs, sold as a Leanpub Package with an MIT zip of its files at US$19 minimum / US$29 suggested, earns 80 % from the shelf's existing readers with no infrastructure, no marketing and no identity step.
